command: pre-registration: R2c contrastive minimal-pair role-token bank, stage-1 offline gate, stage-2 H1-H4

metrics.H1: stage 2 GO: D = bank_rc2 - 0.5 zs - 0.5 ceiling > 0 over 300 paired fresh_rb2 episodes, one-sided two-level cluster bootstrap (B 10000, seed 0)
metrics.H2: bank_rc2 > zs, exact two-sided sign test on discordant pairs
metrics.H3: bank_rc2 > R2's bank, exact two-sided sign test on discordant pairs
metrics.H4: R2's 8 damage cells, routed bank_rc2 vs parity, non-inferior at margin 0.05 (one-sided cluster bootstrap)
metrics.disclosure: seen before this row: R2's published results (docs/PLAN_R2.md section 7: totals zs 170 / bank 181 / ceiling 223, the junk check's fit gains 1.7-7.5% relative and held-out gains ~0, 9 of 16 flagged), which motivated the probe and set MARGIN 0.02 at the low end of R2's fit-demo gains; --plan of rc2 (partner texts, tiers, demo and frame counts per key; no loss, no outcome); a pipeline smoke (RC2_SMOKE=1, 20 steps on O|frying pan, results/rc2/smoke, no ledger row; held-out scores not printed or read; its log showed the contrast loss rising 2.7% at step 20 with the hinge at 0; LAMBDA / MARGIN unchanged).  No R2c fit, token, held-out score or rollout exists.  Stage-2 serving code is not written yet: it will reuse rb2_bank.py's serve / roll / type / read pipeline unchanged except the arm, and an amendment row will be recorded before any stage-2 rollout.
metrics.family: Holm over H1-H4 at alpha 0.05 (stage 2 only)
metrics.objective: L = FM(tok|p)/Lbar0_p + 1.0 * relu(0.02 - (FM(tok|c) - FM(none|c))/FM(none|c)); p batch = R2's (same fit frames, sampling seed 13), contrast batch 32 partner role-phase frames on its own seed-14 streams
metrics.stage1_compare: R2's tokens scored on the identical held-out frames and draws (descriptive)
metrics.stage1_gate: gain_p > 0 for >= 8 of 16 R2c tokens AND spec = gain_p - gain_c > 0 for >= 8 of 16 (no-partner keys fail spec); held-out 16 + 16 demos per key, <= 24 frames each, 4 draws; fail -> stop, no rollouts
metrics.written_before: any R2c fit, held-out score, rollout or read
